# Cameo — account brief

## Who
Cameo describes itself as "Cameo | Personalized videos from your favorite stars — Book personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities." ([source](https://cameo.com/)). Its GitHub org lists the domain cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 31 public repos and 240 followers ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).
- cameo/cameo-app was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)).
- The App Store listing has 95,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- There were 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- The homepage links a careers page ([source](https://cameo.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@cameo-maintainer-1), top contributor to cameo/cameo-app with 203 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@cameo-maintainer-2), top contributor to cameo/cameo-app with 151 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@cameo-maintainer-3), top contributor to cameo/cameo-app with 77 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)).

## Why now
cameo/cameo-app was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)), and the App Store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). The app runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 203 commits in cameo-app, which builds with eas.json on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)). The repo also runs its own GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). When you need a fix in front of those users, does it go out over the air, or does it wait on the next build through those workflows?
